card.name: Digits just before a five
card.fires_on: The first digit of a two-digit number in dose ranges, or the spot right before a number, where the next digit is likely 5 (such as 15 or 25). It also fires on 'of' or a space before a number like 10 or 5.

modes.label: Leading digit of a range
modes.description: The first digit of a number in a mg/kg dose range, where a 5 comes next.

modes.label: Word before a dose amount
modes.description: A linking word or space right before a number in a dose-increment phrase.
